summary: Preinstall script downloads Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package declares a `preinstall` script (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/ into the package directory, marks it executable, and then invokes it against a 727KB obfuscated bundled script `math_init.js` shipped in the tarball. `setup.mjs` itself is obfuscated using obfuscator.io-style transforms (hex identifiers `_0xXXXX`, per-scope proxy objects with garbled keys). `math_init.js` is a Bun-compiled bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs`) using a shuffling routine and a ~2000-entry constant array to hide its contents. The alternate-runtime execution path (`bun math_init.js`) causes attacker-controlled code to run on every `npm install`, bypassing Node-focused analyzers. The remainder of the tarball (`dist/index.js`, `src/`) contains only trivial React hook re-exports consistent with the advertised description, serving as a decoy for the install-time payload. The package sits under the `@servicetitan` scope but the install-time behavior is inconsistent with a React hooks library.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
